CLAIMS.claim: Built a manufacturing data platform processing 1M+ rows through a medallion pipeline with 212 passing tests.
CLAIMS.metric: 212 passed on 458,166 production rows (1,064,166 generated total)
CLAIMS.rewrite_to: Manufacturing medallion pipeline (Raw/Silver/Gold/Mart) verified on 458k production rows, 212 tests passing. Quarantine DLQ and rerun idempotency both proven; the contract-gate fail-open path is a known open defect.
CLAIMS.why: The dataset is synthetic, and 212/212 only reproduces after running the generator because data/raw/* is gitignored. Naming the open defect unprompted is stronger than being asked about it.

CLAIMS.claim: Real-time ONNX inference at 22 fps with sub-50ms latency.
CLAIMS.metric: P50 43.8ms / P95 81.6ms / P99 174.8ms; per-camera cost 44.1ms to 41.0ms from 1 to 8 cameras
CLAIMS.rewrite_to: ONNX/YOLOv8 defect detection at 640x640: measured P50 43.8ms, P99 174.8ms on CPU, with per-camera cost flat from 1 to 8 cameras. Corrupt-model fail-closed behaviour verified.
CLAIMS.why: Real-time and sub-50ms are not supported. P50 is 43.8ms but P99 is 174.8ms, so quoting only P50 hides a 4x tail. The multi-camera figure is a sequential microbenchmark and must be labelled as one.

CLAIMS.claim: Implemented enterprise SLA management for IT service desk.
CLAIMS.metric: SLA targets exact to the second; 336 tests passing; tampered-backup restore refused
CLAIMS.rewrite_to: ITSM platform with 336 passing tests: exact SLA target computation, enforced ticket state machine with terminal states, and checksum-verified backup restore that refuses a tampered archive. All SLA accounting is 24x7 wall-clock; there is no business calendar.
CLAIMS.why: Enterprise SLA implies business-hours awareness, and there is none: a P1 opened Friday 23:00 breaches before anyone is on shift. Naming the 24x7 limitation is required for the claim to be true.

CLAIMS.claim: Implemented secret rotation, SBOM generation and supply-chain attestation across the deployment pipeline.
